quote.text: A man who makes a decision without listening to both sides is unjust, even if his ruling is a fair one.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Just as a parent listens to each child’s story, consider every voice before making a decision in the family. This not only cultivates trust but also nurtures the child's growth into a fair and thoughtful individual.
    • Engaging with both sides when issues arise teaches young ones the art of empathy, ensuring that discipline and guidance come from a place of balanced understanding.
  • Leadership
    • True leadership is earned by assiduously seeking multiple perspectives, for decisions made in isolation can diminish the trust of your followers—even if the outcome appears sound.
    • By listening to contrasting viewpoints, a leader fosters an environment of fairness and accountability, ensuring that decision-making processes reinforce collective wisdom and unity.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, gathering feedback from various stakeholders is essential; relying on a single viewpoint, no matter how rational it appears, can lead to overlooked challenges and missed opportunities.
    • Embracing diverse perspectives encourages innovative solutions that are not only fair but also more resilient in adapting to the ever-changing market needs.
